  PROBLEM: A push between the gate’s PR lookup and the later branch fetch leaves reviewers reading the gate-time tree while the workflow fetches, reviews the diff for, and can authorize auto-merge of the newer head.
  WHY: For a gate lookup of head A followed by a push to head B before the fetch, `GITHUB_WORKSPACE` remains at A, while `WORKSPACE_PATH` and `INITIAL_HEAD_SHA` advance to B. The auto-merge head check can pass for B even though reviewers used A’s files. Keep both review trees pinned to the same SHA or stop the run when they differ.
